description.value: Drive-in frontcountry campground on Pender Island within Gulf Islands National Park Reserve, reached by BC Ferries ferry; a short trail on the western side links to local hiking routes outside the park. Open May 15–September 30 only.

address.value: 5714 Canal Rd, Pender Island, BC V0N 2M1, Canada
